profile_text.body:
Tobii Dynavox describes itself as a global, full-service provider of assistive communication solutions for people with disabilities. According to its site, it makes communication apps and AAC devices, speech generating devices, and eye trackers controlled by eye gaze, touch and switch access. The company says its products are purpose-built for AAC (augmentative and alternative communication) and designed to be customized, so clinicians can set goals for clients and adapt the solutions over time. It names autism, ALS/MND and cerebral palsy among the conditions its products address, and its site features a physician, husband and father with ALS/MND who uses AAC.

The company's tracked product is Boardmaker, listed under Education and Research AI. It is described as symbol-based visual supports and AAC materials for teachers, therapists and students, with student access through Student Center accounts under a teacher license. AI features for the product are not verified. Pricing is listed as Personal at $99/year for 1 learner and Professional at $199/year for up to 10 students, with organization volume pricing and a 60-day free trial. Data privacy terms for Boardmaker Online are posted in the SDPC registry under New York Education Law 2-d.
